tool.name: OpenReadout batch table
tool.description: one tidy table over many instrument files, joined to a sample sheet
tool.command: #import re mkdir inputs && #for $f in $inputs #set $fname = re.sub('[^\w\-.]', '_', str($f.element_identifier)) ln -s '$f' 'inputs/$fname' && #end for #if $sample_sheet #set $sheet_ext = {'tabular': 'tsv', 'tsv': 'tsv', 'csv': 'csv', 'xlsx': 'xlsx', 'txt': 'txt'}.get(str($sample_sheet.ext), 'csv') ln -s '$sample_sheet' 'sample_sheet.$sheet_ext' && #end if openreadout '$measure.name' inputs/ --tidy #if $sample_sheet --sample-sheet 'sample_sheet.$sheet_ext' #end if #if $measure.name == 'stats' --per '$measure.per' #elif $measure.name == 'table' #if str($measure.compensate) != 'none' --compensate '$measure.compensate' #end if #end if #for $w in $filters --where '$w.condition' #end for -o table.csv #if str($summary.by).strip() && openreadout summarize table.csv --by '$summary.by' #if str($summary.values).strip() --value '$summary.values' #end if #if $summary.test.kind != 'none' --test '$summary.test.kind' --control '$summary.test.control' #end if -o summary.csv && mv summary.csv '$summary_table' #end if && mv table.csv '$table'

param.name: inputs
param.label: Instrument files
param.help: Files are named after their Galaxy dataset names, which the sample sheet can refer to

param.name: sample_sheet
param.label: Sample sheet or plate layout
param.help: CSV, tabular or XLSX. The join key is chosen from the data (file name, sample id recorded in the file, well, barcode, ...) and reported

param.name: name
param.label: Measure
param.option: table: FCS events per parameter (n, median, mean, sd, min, max) or plate reads per well
stats: pixel statistics per image and channel
trace: signal statistics per trace, sweep and channel
info: one row of header metadata per file

param.name: by
param.label: Summarize by these columns
param.help: Comma-separated, e.g. condition,dose. Empty: no summary

param.name: values
param.label: Value columns
param.help: Comma-separated; default: the measure's main values

param.name: control
param.label: Control group
param.help: A value of the first summary column

param.name: control
param.label: Control group
param.help: A value of the first summary column

tool.help:
**What it does**
Measures many raw instrument files the same way and returns **one tidy table** (``openreadout <measure> --tidy``): one row per file and per image and channel (``stats``), trace, sweep and channel (``trace``), FCS parameter or plate well (``table``), or one row of header metadata per file (``info``). Files that cannot be read become rows with an ``error``, so nothing is dropped silently.
A **sample sheet** or **plate layout** (CSV, tabular or XLSX) is joined to the rows: the join key is chosen from the data (the file name, the sample id recorded in the file, the well, a barcode, ...). Give the sheet a column with the dataset names (e.g. ``tube_a.fcs``) to join on file names.
The optional **group summary** (``openreadout summarize``) reports n, mean, sd, sem, median, min, max and CV % per group, and a Welch t-test or Mann-Whitney U test of each group against a control.
@HELP_FOOTER@
